pr_body:
* Move HttpValidationProblemDetails to Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http per API review
* Return Content-Type headers when returning ProblemDetails responses

Fixes #34509

issue_context.title: Problem Details related methods on Results should set the content type to "application/problem+json"
issue_context.body: The methods `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.Results.Problem` and `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.Results.ValidationProblem` directly return a new `ObjectResult` response but do not change the content type to "application/problem+json" so the default content type of "application/json" is set instead.
comments: @pranavkm @rafikiassumaniMSFT I don't think we triaged this one today.

review_comments: Ugh, callsites like this are what make trimming hard. I guess we'll need new result types and overloads to fix the problem.

> I guess we'll need new result types and overloads

Sorry, I don't super follow.

To allow for annotating things using the DAM attributes we either need a Type argument to flow or a generic argument to flow. That means ObjectResult needs a Type argument or it needs to be generic (ObjectResult\<T\>). Then you would mark those with the attributes to make sure stuff doesn't get trimmed but maybe this is premature.
